subtitle.en: Screenshots taken with the editor's depth mode, which makes the island look like Limbo.
subtitle.zh: 用编辑器的深度模式拍的截图，整座岛看上去像《Limbo》。

translator.note: 原文 9 张图排在同一行，保留为一个占位段落；标题里的 Limbo 兼指游戏《Limbo》与「悬而未决」之意；图片链接指向原文上传的最大尺寸原图。

blocks.en: We have this depth mode in the editor, that I've never really used for anything other than taking neat screenshots for fun. It's been a while since the last post, so I thought it might be cool to share some. It's difficult to find interesting new screenshots to share lately, since we've already shown a lot of the game and don't want to ruin the exploration when it comes out!
blocks.zh: 我们编辑器里有个深度模式，除了拿它拍些好看的截图玩之外，我从没真正用它做过别的事。距上次发帖已经有一阵子了，所以我想分享几张应该会挺不错。最近很难找到有意思的新截图来分享，因为我们已经展示了很多游戏内容，不想在游戏发售时毁掉探索的乐趣！
